$comment: Canonical Cork deployment addresses/config. Runtime behavior: the tool fetches the latest copy of THIS file from GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com, main branch) with TTL caching; this committed copy ships with the distribution as the fallback when the fetch fails. Addresses are CREATE2-verifiable where an attestation exists (cork_capabilities topic:'verify'). Partial chains omit unknown contracts deliberately — handlers gate per capability.
$v13Comment: 42161 + 8453 defaults are phoenix v1.3.0-rc.1 (github.com/Cork-Technology/phoenix v1.3.0-rc.1, prerelease 2026-08-07): identical CREATE2 addresses on both chains via the Safe Singleton Factory; runtime hashes chain-verified, pool-manager impl slot + adapter CORK()/BUNDLER3() bindings re-verified on-chain 2026-08-07. bundler3 per chain comes from the deployed CorkAdapter's own BUNDLER3() immutable (Morpho infra, not in the release table). Adopted together with market-registry 0.3.2 (Zian's redeploy against this pool manager) — the generations are ALIGNED. The previous Arbitrum production stack (the venue's existing markets live there until the venue migrates) is preserved as deploymentProfiles['42161']['arbitrum-v1.1']; rollover redeployed 2026-08-13 as v0.1.0-rc.2 against the v1.3 pool manager (see $rolloverComment).
$fusionComment: 1inch Fusion settlement reference set (third-party, classification only — the ACTIVE settlement is always decoded from the order's own extension bytes). current = the v3.1 layout this tool prices (fusion-protocol deployments@master, CREATE3, code verified on-chain 2026-07-28: mainnet=Settlement, arbitrum=SimpleSettlement; base verified 2026-08-07: runtime byte-identical to Arbitrum's SimpleSettlement except ONE 20-byte immutable, the chain's WETH — 0x4200…0006 vs 0x82aF…Bab1); legacy = recognized-but-refused older layouts (v2 present on all three chains; v1 is mainnet-only and LOP v3 era).
$marketRegistryComment: MarketRegistry stack, contracts release 0.3.3 (Zian's full redeploy 2026-08-10 — the CREATE2-collision fix: the wrapper key doubles as the CREATE2 salt and is now keccak256(abi.encode(registryAddress, ca, ref, caSource, refSource)), so every registry instance derives its own salt space and the sUSDe/sUSDS@42161 brick cannot recur. Verified empirically 2026-08-10: the pair simulates DEPLOYABLE on the new registry and still reverts on the old one. Identical addresses on 42161 + 8453 via ONE AtomicDeployer batch — guarded CREATE2, salts + initCodeHashes attested in packages/core/src/config.ts, re-derived locally from the 0.3.3 broadcast records and matched against BOTH chains' live addresses 2026-08-10). `recipes` are NAMED HINTS for the deprecated mode sugar only — membership is decided solely by isRecipe on chain: as of 2026-08-10 all three recipes are APPROVED on Base but NOT YET on Arbitrum (isRecipe false ×3, API /v1/42161/recipes empty) — JIT resolution on 42161 answers recipe_not_found until the approvals land. POOL_CREATOR + FEE_MANAGER are GRANTED to the new adapter on BOTH chains (verified on-chain 2026-08-10 — the roles_not_granted era is over; adapter LOP/POOL_MANAGER/CONTROLLER/MARKET_REGISTRY bindings all verified). The 0.3.2 predecessor (registry 0xF5323F305360A792284814a7EDe78c2209A1DC94, adapter 0x1b754F17EDd87784b01542aAe0e4CA672CFdc7CE; no markets were ever created through it — its roles landed only with this redeploy) and the 0.3.0 one before it are superseded and dropped from config — git history has their full record; the adapter.MARKET_REGISTRY() binding guard refuses cross-generation reads. The PRE-2.1.0 generation (different interface, misdecoding answers) stays under marketRegistryLegacy, reachable only with CORK_ENABLE_DEPRECATED=1.
$rolloverComment: Rollover ERC-7683 stack (rollover-private v0.1.0-rc.2 @ 5af1048e, deployed 2026-08-13; identical CREATE2 addresses on 42161+8453, chain-verified 2026-08-19: ERC-5267 domains + DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() golden vectors in packages/core/test/rollover.test.ts). rc.2 changed the OrderData/RolloverParams typehashes (jitMarketHash), so the July 2026 generation below is RETIRED: the venue archives it and admits only rc.2 settlers; rc.2-typed digests do not verify on the old settlers. legacyGenerations exists for event-history scans (full-decentralized fills/contracts) and retired-settler teaching only.
$implementationsComment: Approved implementations per interface role (2026-08-12; the same schema is proposed for the distribution repo — see github.com/Cork-Technology/distribution/issues/1): the INTERFACE is what this tool supports; an implementation joins `approved` only after the behavioral suite passes against it (the fork harnesses: JitOrderRoundTrip210, cork-periphery JitFill210/032 + pool groups). Hashes are keccak256(eth_getCode) — equal to EXTCODEHASH for deployed code — captured live 2026-08-12. `proxy: eip1967` marks a role whose address is a proxy: the guard resolves the implementation from the EIP-1967 slot and hashes THAT code, because the proxy's own code never changes on an upgrade. Roles resolve against the address blocks that already own them (deployments / marketRegistry) — no address is duplicated here.
